claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'EPAL' stamped blocks consistent with European (foreign) standard pallets, but photos 0/1 show a different, dirtier stack with only a partially legible stamp, and photo 3 shows a separate newer-looking pallet with no visible stamp at all. No single shot confirms all units on offer are the same foreign-certified batch.

risks.risk: Mixed lot quality: stacks in photos 0/1 look weathered/dirty vs. cleaner EPAL stack in photo 2 vs. single newer pallet in photo 3 — may not be one uniform batch.
risks.proof: Wide shot showing all pallets being sold together with stamps visible on each, plus a count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-quality visible batch (photo 0/1 condition)

risks.proof: Seller statement with a clear count, confirmed by a photo showing the full lot with pallets countable.
risks.if_unproven: priced per-unit at worst case, no bulk discount assumed

risks.risk: Wood condition (rot, moisture, insect damage) not visible at this resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of wood grain, cut edges, and undersides of several pallets.

risks.risk: Heat-treatment/chemical treatment (ISPM-15 compliance) unconfirmed despite EPAL stamp sighting.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the stamped block showing full ISPM-15/HT mark, not just partial 'EPAL' text.

risks.risk: Nail/fastener condition (rust, protruding nails) not visible.
risks.proof: Close-up of corners and nail heads on multiple pallets.

risks.risk: Load capacity/structural integrity of the pallets unknown.
risks.proof: Video of a pallet being lifted or stood on to show flex/strength.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard light-duty, not heavy-duty

proof_requests: Full lot photo with all pallets visible and countable
Close-up of stamped blocks on each distinct stack (full ISPM-15/EPAL mark)
Close-up of wood grain, undersides, and corners for rot/insect/nail condition
Confirmation of exact quantity being sold as one unit
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is wooden pallets, so it can be priced, but visible inconsistencies across photos (dirty vs. clean stacks, unstamped single unit) and unverifiable treatment/condition claims mean it must be priced at worst-case low-grade, mixed-quality stock until closer proof is shown.
